boundary: workspace state carries identity only (raceId, frameIndex, selectedDriverId) — no scientific payloads, no frame data, no probabilities, no intervals
prefetch: no future prefetch of any kind; store issues zero requests by construction (no fetch in core/URL/links/adapter/provider, pinned by tests)
downstream: causal gating (<= T visibility) remains owned by existing consumers; navigation through the store cannot leak future information because there is nothing future-bearing to leak
eligibility: no availability/eligibility logic in the store; valid workspace + MC2-unsupported remains valid
